title: Ordnungspolizei Doppelkasten radiograms, 1942 (Weierud 2020, NARA RG 457)

steps.what: Read both German key manuals and NSA articles; confirmed double pass from November 1941.
Discriminators show the seven 27 Feb parts share one key (970 letters).
Single encipherment, all line lengths and pair orders.
Double encipherment by annealing and related searches on a synthetic 970-letter text with known key.
Known-plaintext solver recovers the boxes from about 80-111 pairs on synthetic data.
Key-free alignment of Hanyok's A115 text to its ciphertext over many spellings and layouts.

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only attacks on the double-pass Doppelkasten (annealing, SAT, relaxation) failed on the 970-letter 27 Feb key, and the Hanyok A115 plaintext could not be aligned; a known-plaintext solver needs about 80 pairs.
outcome.notes: Needs about 80 known plaintext pairs for one key (Bletchley's German decrypts in TNA HW 16/17).

prior.where: A115 decrypt printed by Hanyok (English rendering); the 27 Feb messages are unread in public

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
